items.summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce a new Copilot skill, "Summarize sales for leaders," by early November 2026, enabling users to quickly create executive sales summary presentations focused on performance, outlook, risks, and decisions. No admin action or changes to data handling are required.

items.summary: A new Copilot skill in PowerPoint will help users create customer review decks focused on business goals and outcomes. Rolling out worldwide from late October to early November 2026, it requires no admin action and does not change data handling or introduce new AI interactions.

items.title: MC1529477: Microsoft PowerPoint: Review sales pipeline Copilot skill
items.summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce a new Copilot skill, Review sales pipeline, by early November 2026. It helps users create or update pipeline and forecast presentations focused on opportunity movement, risks, and next actions. No admin action is needed, and it does not change data handling or AI interaction methods.

items.title: MC1529472: Frontier expands to include public previews in Microsoft Teams, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.summary: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Frontier expands to offer public preview features in Teams, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, and SharePoint, alongside Copilot. items.title: MC1529467: Microsoft Windows: Updates to address compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
items.summary: Microsoft is updating Windows, Edge, and WebView2 to block eight compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys by late October 2026. Organizations must allow automatic updates, manage disconnected devices, and replace certificates chaining to these keys to maintain trust and security.

items.title: MC1529463: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
items.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations using MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, or entitlement policies must replace it to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. Action is required before this date to maintain proper functionality.

items.title: MC1519871: Copilot Code is rolling out in Frontier
items.summary: Copilot Code, an AI-powered coding tool in Microsoft Copilot, is rolling out in the Frontier program starting late October 2026. It enables users with licenses and spending policies to build, refine, and publish apps using natural language, with admin-controlled usage-based billing and optional local coding on PC.

items.title: MC1069563: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
items.summary: Microsoft 365 admin center introduces a preview usage report for managing metered costs of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing. It shows message consumption by tenant, user, and agent, with alerts for over 2000 messages. Rollout starts end of April 2027, no admin action needed.

items.title: MC1384420: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
items.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders (e.g., AppData) during egress actions starting late February 2027. Admins must update policies, deploy anti-malware client 4.18.26051+, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

items.title: MC1465763: Microsoft Entra: Prepare for Microsoft to disable unused or unsuccessful SMS first-factor sign-in
items.summary: Microsoft will disable SMS first-factor sign-in in Microsoft Entra tenants with no successful or only unsuccessful SMS sign-ins in the past 30 days, starting mid-September to November 2026. SMS for MFA and password reset remains unaffected. Admins should review usage, notify users, and ensure alternate sign-in methods.

items.title: MC1523090: Microsoft Teams: Initiate side conversations within the meeting chat window
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start or continue private side conversations within the meeting chat window, rolling out globally from January 2027. No admin action is needed, chat history is preserved, and users can disable the side-chat tab if desired. No compliance issues identified.

items.title: MC1528013: Microsoft SharePoint: SharePoint Server access through the mobile apps will be retired
items.summary: SharePoint Server access via the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android will be retired starting November 27, 2026. These apps will support SharePoint Online only. Organizations should notify users and update documentation accordingly before this change.

items.title: MC1528011: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will support external presenters in event group chat for meetings with the "Enable Green room" option. Rollout starts November 2026. External collaboration must be enabled. External presenters can read and post messages, with tenant IDs updated accordingly, enabling cross-tenant communication.

items.title: MC1528007: Join button will require HTTPS meeting links
items.summary: Starting late November 2026, Outlook's Join button will only appear for meetings with HTTPS join URLs. Meetings with HTTP-only URLs will not show the button. Organizations should ensure their meeting providers and integrations generate HTTPS links to avoid impact. No action is needed if HTTPS URLs are already used.

items.title: MC1528006: Microsoft Authenticator: Improved backup and restore experience for Android
items.summary: Microsoft Authenticator for Android will improve backup and restore with clearer setup guidance and support for passkeys starting mid-January 2027. Users must enable Google One backup and screen lock. Work/school accounts aren’t backed up, and backup works only in the Android personal profile. No admin action needed.

items.title: MC1528003: Microsoft Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.summary: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone enables natural language editing and task continuation outside the app. Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2026, it enhances mobile Excel use with secure Microsoft 365 integration, allowing quick data insights, edits, and formula updates without compliance concerns.

items.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication starting February 1, 2027. items.summary: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting early November 2026, allowing users to satisfy MFA without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

items.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
items.summary: OneDrive for Business will improve Windows desktop sync error messages for paths exceeding the 520-character limit, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out January 2027, aims to reduce confusion and support tickets with no admin action required.

items.title: MC1510951: Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada
items.summary: Windows updates support 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia, effective November 1, 2026, when clocks won't be set back. Install updates before then and select the new region-specific time zones to ensure correct local time on devices. Guidance for Outlook and Microsoft 365 is provided.

items.summary: Admins with Global admin or reader roles can manage up to 100 authoritative SharePoint Online sites in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search via the admin center, enhancing search relevance. This AI-driven feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and includes centralized governance and bulk import/export capabilities.

items.summary: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will enhance export capabilities in Inventory and Cloud Update views, adding more device and update details, filtered exports, and new columns like Cloud Update Status. Rollout starts November 2026. No action or compliance changes are needed.

items.summary: Microsoft is retiring AI Builder credits by November 1, 2026, replacing them with Copilot Credits. Organizations must plan and purchase Copilot Credits before AI Builder credits expire to avoid service interruptions. AI Builder features continue, but licensing and credit management require admin action.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

Admins must update Windows, Outlook time zones, review meetings, update Teams Rooms, and keep apps current. Testing and support case submission with #Canada Time-Zone are advised.

items.summary: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules to auto-reply with saved templates, automating repetitive responses. items.title: MC1492154: Enhanced M365 Copilot Memory - Copilot is now personalized with work data
items.summary: M365 Copilot now uses Microsoft 365 data to provide personalized work responses, rolling out worldwide from early October to November 2026. Users can disable this via settings, and admins can control it with enhancedPersonalizationSetting. No admin action or compliance issues are required.

items.title: MC1239927: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams: Bilingual consecutive interpretation mode with Interpreter agent
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams introduces a new Consecutive Interpretation mode, enabling structured, turn-by-turn multilingual meetings. items.title: MC1220762: Retirement notice: MDE and XDR Advanced Hunting APIs retiring; migrate to Microsoft Graph Security API
items.summary: Microsoft is retiring the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting APIs by February 1, 2027. Organizations must manually migrate workflows to the Microsoft Graph Security API by January 31, 2027, to ensure continued functionality and improved security integration.
